finding.title: Reference to undefined variable `featured`
finding.description: The component references a `featured` array (e.g., `featured[0].cover`, `featured[0].name`, `featured[0].tagline`) without importing it or defining it locally within the component scope. This will lead to a runtime ReferenceError when the component attempts to render.

remediation.explanation: Ensure all required mock data or state variables are properly imported from mock data sources or managed via component state to avoid runtime failures.
remediation.recommended_fix: Import `featured` from `../data/mockData` or derive it appropriately from available datasets.

finding.title: Uncontrolled Component State and Disconnected Search Input
finding.description: The Browse component accepts a `searchQuery` prop, but renders an internal search input element that lacks a `value` and `onChange` handler. Consequently, typing into this input field will not update the parent component's state or trigger the filtering logic, rendering the input effectively non-functional and introducing confusion for maintainers and users.

remediation.explanation: Connecting the input element to state management ensures proper data flow and interactivity, adhering to standard React patterns where inputs are properly controlled.
remediation.recommended_fix: Accept an `onSearchChange` callback prop or lift the search state management appropriately, then bind the input's `value` and `onChange` event to it.

finding.title: Single Responsibility Principle violation: Player component handles multiple domains
finding.description: The Player component directly manages track state, playback progress intervals, volume control, mute toggles, shuffle/repeat states, liked status, and layout rendering all within a single monolithic function.

remediation.explanation: Splitting the component into smaller sub-components (e.g., TrackInfo, PlaybackControls, VolumeControls) and extracting custom hooks for player logic improves testability and separation of concerns.
remediation.recommended_fix: Extract state management into a custom hook such as usePlayerState() and decompose the JSX into smaller presentation components.

finding.title: Direct Coupling to Hardcoded Mock Data
finding.description: The Queue component imports and directly renders queueTracks from a static mock data source (../data/mockData). This creates tight coupling between the presentational component and test data, preventing the component from receiving dynamic playback state or a customized track list via props.

finding.title: Structural Duplication and Lack of Component Decomposition in ListenNow
finding.description: The ListenNow component renders multiple distinct content sections ("Recently Played", "New Releases", "Made For You") with nearly identical structural layouts, recurring headers, and horizontal scroll containers. Additionally, the component directly imports static mock data instead of receiving data via props or context, reducing modularity, reusability, and testability.

remediation.explanation: Extracting the recurring section structure into a reusable sub-component (e.g., MediaSection) reduces code duplication, lowers cognitive complexity, and improves separation of concerns by isolating presentation layout from domain data sources.
remediation.recommended_fix: Create a reusable MediaSection component that accepts a title, items list, and rendering callback or size variant as props.

finding.title: Manual interval timer used for audio/track progress simulation
finding.description: The component uses a React useEffect hook combined with setInterval to manually simulate track progress increments every 100ms. Managing playback timing via manual JavaScript intervals can lead to drift, unnecessary re-renders, and potential timer leaks if cleanup fails or state updates outpace the interval tick.

remediation.explanation: Using HTML5 Audio APIs or requestAnimationFrame provides more accurate timing for media playback components and decouples UI state updates from manual interval management.
remediation.recommended_fix: Consider leveraging standard HTML5 <audio> elements or native media hooks to drive playback progress rather than custom interval state tickers.

finding.title: Structural Duplication in Navigation Items
